name: Ashveil Free Town
summary: The only governed ground in the Ashlands: a chartered city-state one mile wide, jointly held by the Velkash Crown's road-charter and the Censer's crossing-writ. Warden Otta Kell serves two masters, collects tolls for both, and keeps the continent's best data on the Quiet in a private tally-house.

government.title: Warden of the Cross
government.current: Warden Otta Kell (dual-appointed: Crown charter + Censer writ)
government.note: The dual appointment means two paymasters, two sets of orders, and one very careful woman.

population.note: garrison families, toll-keepers, ash-farmers who won't leave
stone-wardens; they volunteer for work no one else takes
ash-line readers; never stay the night

laws: Charter law inside the walls (Kell's word is final); Censer writ at the Veiled Gate and cloister; the Edict of Silence enforced on all papers passing the toll.

relations.note: Funds the road; audits the tolls; ignores the town otherwise.
Everything beyond the walls is the March.
The Ash Cloister tests papers; Kell counts bells.

history_notes: Chartered when the King's Road was re-cut after the Rebuilding; the charter has never been renegotiated — both signatories fear opening it.
adventure_hooks: Kell offers players her bell-tally copies if they escort them to the Veil-Wardens — without the Censer learning.
A dawn caravan carries banned texts; players must decide before the toll-gate closes which side of the Edict they stand on.
The silence-bells rang last night. All forty-one. Nobody has rung since, and nobody will say why that is worse.
